capabilities: , Copy file or folder from File Explorer
Copy text contents of Markdown and TXT files
Copy relative and absolute vault paths
Copy full contents of active note
extras: Requires macOS for native file object copying.
problem: Obsidian lacks native functionality within the File Explorer to copy files as native macOS objects, copy file contents, or easily insert Markdown code blocks.
summary: A macOS utility that adds advanced file and content copying actions to the File Explorer, allowing users to copy files as native objects and insert Markdown code blocks.
